messages:
sarah (sec-eng): Heads-up — customer reported SIEM drop because our webhook payload fields are truncated and they can't map tenant_id. Any quick fixes?
kevin (onboarding): Saw this before with Datadog HEC — long 'message' fields get truncated to ~1k and their ingestion pipeline drops the event. We should provide both a snippet and a raw_event_len + s3_fallback.
jay (infra): Do we include Content-Length and Content-Encoding? Some SIEMs behave differently if those headers are missing. Also some proxies truncate long headers.
maria (customers): Customer says Splunk HEC returns "event too large" and then their pipeline loses tenant_id. They asked if we can send a stable, signed tenant identifier instead of cleartext tenant_id.
audIt-bot: Published schema draft: schema_version=1.3 includes tenant_id_hash, raw_event_len, kms_signature, payload_snippet, and optional s3_fallback field.
sarah (sec-eng): Proposal: schema v1.3 = hashed tenant id (sha256 prefixed), raw_event_len, payload_snippet, optional s3_fallback (when event size > threshold), and KMS signature header for customers to verify origin.
kevin (onboarding): I'll add Splunk and Datadog mapping examples to the onboarding checklist. Also include a troubleshooting snippet (what fields to look for) and a minimal test payload they can ingest.
jay (infra): I'll ensure we send Content-Length and Content-Encoding: gzip for payloads > 2KB. Also add X-Redwood-Event-Length and X-KMS-Signature headers. For S3 export we will use key prefix: tenant_hash=sha256:.../YYYY/MM/DD/uuid.json.gz for easy tenant partitioning.
sarah (sec-eng): KMS signing rules: canonicalize JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace), sign UTF-8 bytes with customer or platform KMS key, include X-KMS-Key: key-id and X-KMS-Signature: sig:base64. Document rotation semantics.
maria (customers): Can we get a concrete sample payload to give the customer's SIEM team so they can validate ingestion quickly?
jay (infra): Sample (snippet only):
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.3",
  "event_type": "inference.request",
  "tenant_id_hash": "sha256:5f2e9c...",
  "raw_event_len": 6420,
  "payload_snippet": "User asked for a pricing comparison between product A and product B...",
  "s3_fallback": "s3://redwood-audit-exports/tenant=sha256:5f2e9c/2026/03/20/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.json.gz",
  "kms_signature": "sig:BASE64=="
}
```
sarah (sec-eng): Action items: kevin — add sample payloads + Splunk/Datadog mapping to onboarding doc. jay — implement headers, gzip behavior, S3 key prefix, and add integration test. I will update the audit schema doc, add a small regression that forces s3_fallback at >2KB, and notify product of schema bump.
kevin (onboarding): Will add examples and a short checklist for customers (validate X-KMS-Signature, check raw_event_len vs snippet). ETA EOD tomorrow.
maria (customers): Great — we'll run this in their staging SIEM and report back.
jay (infra): Posting PR for header + s3 key changes, will tag for review. @audit-bot please publish final schema after merge.
